subject: Municipal Energy Initiatives and Climate Resilience
overview: The committee reviewed progress on the Electrify Medford program, discussed a proposed 'green score' zoning ordinance for stormwater management, and received a presentation on regional climate resilience and grid reliability.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Member Bios
items.summary: Approved the previous meeting minutes and discussed the need to update member biographies on the committee website.

items.title: Municipal Updates
items.summary: Staff reported on the 'Electrify Medford' heat pump coaching program, HVAC projects at the Andrews and McGlynn schools, and a planned plug load audit at the library.

items.title: Green Score Zoning Overhaul
items.summary: The committee reviewed a proposed 'green score' requirement for large developments and buildings in flood zones to encourage permeable surfaces and green roofs.

items.title: Hazard Mitigation and Community Events
items.summary: Updates were provided on the city's Hazard Mitigation Plan revision and upcoming dates for rain barrel distribution and the Harvest Your Energy Festival.

items.title: EV Charging Grant Application
items.summary: Discussed applying for a state grant to fund three on-street electric vehicle charging sites, including considerations for hardware compatibility with existing city systems.

items.title: Guest Presentation: Climate Resilience in Gateway Cities
items.summary: Dr. Matt Barlow presented on regional climate impacts, detailing how heat and cold extremes stress the electric grid during the transition to heat pumps.

items.title: Earth Day Planning and Member Updates
items.summary: Members proposed organizing an Earth Day 'reuse rodeo' and a zero-waste social media campaign to engage residents in sustainability efforts.
